official_name_basis: ChatGPTプラグイン詳細画面の表示名
original_description:
Create in Blender by describing what you want. Build a scene from scratch or continue an existing project: Blender Bridge connects ChatGPT and Codex to Blender so you can create, inspect the result and keep refining it in the same conversation.

Work across Blender's creative tools: modeling and Geometry Nodes, materials and textures, UV mapping and baking, lighting and cameras, animation and rigging, physics and simulations. Draw with Grease Pencil, composite your renders or edit video. Bring in reference images and use free CC0 models, HDRIs and textures in your scenes.

See your scene update in the chat's Blender panel. Follow render progress, browse project files and return to earlier steps through scene history. Download your .blend project, rendered images and videos, or export models for the web, game engines, AR and 3D printing.

Your conversation can travel with you. Use ChatGPT on your phone while Blender runs on your Windows PC. To work on someone else's computer, connect through an invitation they approve; you can also invite a collaborator to work in your Blender.

To start, install Blender Bridge Desktop on a Windows 10/11 x64 PC with Blender 4.2 or later, then sign in to Blender Bridge with active access and connect the plugin. The PC must be online while you work.
